column1: # Pinned charts of the catalog. One row per app, columns separated by a tab:
#   app      directory of the app (holds app/margo.yaml)
#   chart    chart name, also the repository name under the mirror registry
#   version  chart version; must equal the revision in app/margo.yaml
#   type     mirror: the upstream .tgz is pushed unchanged
#            wrapper: the chart directory in the app is packaged; it vendors
#            the upstream chart unchanged as a dependency
#            local: the chart directory in the app is packaged; it has no
#   source   mirror: the upstream chart (oci://... or <https repo>#<name>)
#            wrapper, local: the chart directory, relative to the repository root
#   sha256   SHA-256 of the upstream .tgz (for a wrapper: of the vendored
